found_values.value: 150 A onboard (F2, continuous), 300 A external (V50, peak 30 s): each path's rated current; V48 opens each switch at twice it. Applied as 'trip inside full scale'

100 degC at the sensor beside the onboard shunt, derived from V49 (switch array budgeted at TJ 100 degC); no stated trip level exists. Applied as 'trip temperature' and the Onboard shunt's 100 degC terminal

The sensor beside the onboard shunt, onboard path only; the ESC cuts its own power (OpenYGE POWER_CUT), no motor limit exists, the external path's thermal design is round 3. Applied as 'watched temperature'
One averaged reading above the threshold, read at the 20 ms sample, trips; the tree's only current ceiling aborts at once. Applied as 'reading window'
None applies (V160). Detection to disarm at most 20 ms; the pack switch opens when the enable falls, 155 to 185 ms after the last heartbeat edge, all power switches open within 200 ms

Nothing: the action disarms the outputs; the pack switches follow the enable node through the latch alone (no processor between GPIO6 and a gate). ALERT may reach a GPIO. As R3's V53. Applied as 'switch action'
